payload.reason: The evidence provides details about human evaluation results for text generation tasks, specifically in the context of extractive summarization.

claims.text: Human evaluation results for extracted summaries are demonstrated to provide an intuitive understanding of the proposed system's superiority.
Two samples for human evaluation and case analysis of extractive summaries predicted by the HiStruct+ model are provided, comparing them with the gold summary.
The evaluation results of the HiStruct+ models indicate systematic assessments of summarization performance, which includes human evaluation aspects.
